findings.summary: Manifest projection removed an unmapped raw reply before failed-settlement cleanup could recover its immutable message/write identity; message ID remained reusable.
findings.repro: Original tests/unit/test_reply_links.py::test_erased_landed_prefix_is_not_relinked_by_failed_settlement failed with missing erased identity; author added premanifest exact intake tombstones and file-backed interruption/restart/explicit-retry test.
findings.review: Current line 694 tombstones mapped and exact unmapped claims after legal-hold preflight and before manifest append. Independent 3 reply tests pass; exact namespace/message/write-ID ledger controls 2 pass 1 optional skip; root reply/F3/witness 46 pass.

findings.summary: Rolling-prune fixture manually advanced protected records checkpoint, violating atomic records-fold ownership.
findings.review: Author replaced direct offset with actual advance_records fold; independent target 1 passed and prune/reopen erasure fence assertions preserved.

findings.summary: Worker fixture used empty WRITE and manual protected records offset.
findings.repro: Focused original worker module failed on empty WRITE.
findings.review: Canonical record WRITE plus actual fold preserves before/after prune checks; independent whole module 4 passed.

findings.summary: Batch fixtures assumed records checkpoint stayed zero although native atomic fold advances it with WRITE.
findings.repro: Three top-level failures in batch checkpoint expectations.
findings.review: Assertions now distinguish records cursor at head from held vector/lexical marks; independent 3 affected tests pass.

findings.summary: Trust ranking fixture allowed inherited ONNX reranker min-max scaling to mask positive relevance scores; read golden froze scoring time but not Engine clock.
findings.repro: Three top-level failures, including two score-only golden drifts.
findings.review: Rerank chain off for ranking fixture, explicit unweighted/weighted controls, Engine clock frozen for golden; independent target ranking 1 passed and prior combined three passed. Original golden unchanged.

findings.summary: Offline hash fixtures inherited default ONNX reranker, changing batch/parity/N5 expected mechanics.
findings.review: Three eval fixture/config files explicitly isolate rerank chain; no assertions, golden or production changed; independent affected eval suite 7 passed.

findings.summary: RM-162 next-action still said RM-144 quarantine remained although RM-144 entries had been removed.
findings.repro: RM-144 DONE row and empty tests/quarantine.txt contradicted current RM-162 wording.
findings.review: Root corrected next action, retained historical row text, regenerated two HTML views; refresh_tracker.py --check passed 342 tasks.
